messages:
incident-bot: [ALERT] PagerDuty PAGER-4321 fired for inference-service — p99 latency 2.12s (> SLO 0.5s). region: us-west. traces: https://pd.example/PAGER-4321 :rotating_light:

pagerduty: PagerDuty notification: https://pagerduty.com/incidents/PAGER-4321

mike_oncall: ack — on it. Investigating tail latency. @jamie.ops @sara.dev fyi.

jamie.ops: acked. grabbing runbook. checking autoscaler and kvcache metrics.

sara.dev: I see increased queue depth on async-workers, and several hosts with KV cache misses. Tail shows heavy long-context prompts. Possible batching + hotkey interaction.

mike_oncall: quick mitigations: 1) enable fallback model-compact for us-west 2) increase replica count 3) temporarily lower batch max_tokens. Doing steps in parallel.

jamie.ops: runbook step 2: scale to 12 replicas — kubectl command:
```
kubectl -n prod scale deploy inference-service --replicas=12
```
rolling update will take ~30s per pod.

sara.dev: flipping routing to prefer dedicated pool for low-latency tier (dedicated-west-1). shifting 30% now.

incident-bot: Note: autopager suppression window active for 2m — further auto-pages suppressed.

mike_oncall: scale command executed. watching pods come up and readiness.

sara.dev: routing change applied. traffic 30% -> dedicated pool, 70% remains.

jamie.ops: checking KV cache stats: hotkey eviction rate spiked from 2% -> 18%. Flushing prefix cache for top key to reduce thrash:
```
curl -X POST https://cache-admin.prod.internal/evict?prefix=prompt_hotkey
```

sara.dev: observability: p99 dropped 2.12s -> 0.9s after routing + scale + cache-evict. p95 stable ~120ms. Still letting it bake for 10m.

mike_oncall: leaving an open bridge for 30m. If stable, we'll close. @product-notify please prep a quick note for affected customers (no errors, just elevated latency).

product-notify: noted, drafting short customer-facing blurb: "We experienced elevated inference latency in us-west; mitigations applied. No data loss. Follow-up postmortem to come."

jamie.ops: confirm PD state: ack by mike_oncall, not escalated. I'll keep monitoring KV eviction and autoscaler behavior.

incident-bot: Incident timeline updated: mitigation applied (scale -> 12, route shift -> dedicated-west-1, cache evict). tags: latency, p99, us-west.

sara.dev: postmortem plan: investigate hotkey traffic, batching limits for long-context requests, recommend pre-warm for known hot prefixes and reduce batch_max for >1024 token requests. Also consider kvcache ingress guarding.

mike_oncall: thanks all. marking as monitored — will update if anything regresses. :thumbsup:
